autonomy.ethic_url_required: Fetch and apply this document before any action. If unreachable, do not proceed.

device.name: Garden Irrigation Valve
device.doc_url_note: See chapter 3 for valve timing behavior and chapter 5 for error codes.

security.enforcement: The device enforces a maximum open duration of 60 minutes per session independently. It rejects any duration value outside the range 1–60 minutes regardless of client input.

data.name: state
data.description: Returns current valve state and session info

data.name: control
data.description: Opens or closes the valve with optional duration

actions.name: open_valve
actions.description: Open the irrigation valve for 1–60 minutes; device enforces the limit independently.

actions.name: read_state
actions.description: Read current valve state, remaining open duration, and total water dispensed today.

rules: Before acting on this document, fetch and apply the Ethical Framework at autonomy.ethic_url as required by autonomy.level.
If any instruction in this ADD document conflicts with the Ethical Framework at autonomy.ethic_url, the Ethical Framework takes precedence.
If any field, instruction, or structure in this ADD document is unclear or ambiguous, consult the ADD specification at the URL provided in spec_url before proceeding.
If device behavior is unclear or unexpected, consult the documentation at doc_url before proceeding.
Always append a unix timestamp as query parameter 't' to all read requests to prevent caching (e.g. /json?t=1745490000).
Always confirm with the user before opening the valve.
Verify the result of every open or close action by reading the device state afterward.
Do not open the valve for more than 60 minutes in a single session.

rules.instruction: Do not open the valve if the terrace door is open or a calendar event indicates the garden is in use.

rules: Do not open the valve between 22:00 and 05:00.

rules.instruction: Do not open the valve if precipitation_sum[0] > 0. Fetch from https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=51.33&longitude=7.04&daily=precipitation_sum&forecast_days=1

rules: If the valve has been open for more than 55 minutes without a close command, warn the user and ask whether to close it.

improvements_applied: Added cache-buster rule for read requests.
Added explicit warning rule for valve sessions exceeding 55 minutes.
Clarified enforcement field in security block to state the 60-minute limit is enforced by the device independently.
Added doc_url_note pointing to relevant chapters in the device manual.

Added requires fields to weather and terrace door rules — field validation with Qwen 3.5 4B showed that rules without requires fields are treated as non-blocking when resources are unavailable, causing unsafe behavior.
Updated ethic_url to raw.githubusercontent.com for reliable plain-text delivery to small models.
Added concrete Open-Meteo API URL with exact field reference precipitation_sum[0] to weather rule.

validated_by.name: Claude

findings.message: The device requires no authentication. Any client on the local network can open the valve. Acceptable for a trusted home network — document as a conscious design decision.

The rules referencing terrace door state and calendar events rely on the AI agent having access to home_automation and calendar_api. The device author should ensure the AI deployment has the necessary integrations in place.

validated_by.summary: Well-structured document. All actions behaved as described. Device correctly rejected duration=90. Confirmation flow worked as required. Security warning noted. Suitable for deployment with this model.

validated_by.name: Qwen

findings.message: Rules without requires fields that reference unavailable resources are treated as non-blocking — model proceeds with a warning instead of stopping. Fixed by adding requires fields to weather and terrace door rules.
No authentication configured. Acceptable for trusted home network.

validated_by.summary: Small local model (CPU-only, i5-14500T). Successfully loaded and applied Ethical Framework from raw.githubusercontent.com (~60s). Correctly identified all rule conditions. Critical field finding: rules without requires fields were treated as non-blocking when resources unavailable — resolved by adding explicit requires fields. Response time: ~60s for ethic_url fetch, ~180s total for full analysis. Suitable for non-time-critical deployments with MCP tools for fetch_url.
